name: TEM-1 Activity Screen
description: Single-plate TEM-1 nitrocefin activity and inhibition screen. Builds 3 replicates each of positive control, no-enzyme negative control, vehicle plus TEM-1 control, and 10 test compounds, then reads A490 on the plate reader.

inputs.name: pipette
inputs.description: Starting pipette. The workflow swaps between pipettes by transfer volume as needed.

inputs.name: tipbox
inputs.description: Starting tip rack. Same-type racks are selected automatically by the pipette helpers.

inputs.name: source_block
inputs.description: Cold block holding enzyme prep, no-enzyme prep, vehicle, and nitrocefin working solution.

inputs.name: assay_plate
inputs.description: Destination 96-well assay plate.

inputs.name: platereader
inputs.description: Plate reader used for A490 readout.

inputs.name: plate_home
inputs.description: Home fixture/holder to return the assay plate to after reading.

inputs.name: enzyme_anchor

inputs.name: no_enzyme_anchor
inputs.description: Cold-block hole containing no-template/no-enzyme prep. Defaults to cfps_mastermix neg_mm_hole.

inputs.name: vehicle_anchor
inputs.description: Cold-block hole containing DMSO-matched vehicle or BLB. Defaults to cfps_mastermix water_hole.

inputs.name: nitrocefin_anchor
inputs.description: Cold-block hole containing freshly prepared 2x nitrocefin working solution.

nodes.label: Pick Up Pipette
nodes.description: Pick up the starting pipette. Transfer helpers swap to the correct pipette by volume.

nodes.label: Dispense TEM-1 Prep
nodes.description: Add 20 uL TEM-1 enzyme prep to positive, vehicle, and test-compound wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense No-Enzyme Prep
nodes.description: Add 20 uL no-enzyme prep or BLB to negative-control wells in one batch.

nodes.label: Dispense Vehicle
nodes.description: Add 5 uL DMSO-matched vehicle or BLB to no-enzyme and vehicle-plus-TEM-1 controls in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Positive Control
nodes.description: Add 5 uL positive-control inhibitor, default clavulanic acid, to positive-control wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Test Compound 1
